name: io.github.mykemueller1-ctrl/action-shift
title: Never86'd Action Shift
description: Restaurant labor, invoice price changes, and daily close checks from data you provide.

tools.name: get_operator_system
tools.description: Return the versioned public Never86 operator OS pack (loop, routines, agents, truth gates, safety, private-store boundary). Call first.

tools.name: get_operator_logic
tools.description: Fetch one public Never86 rulebook domain, or the full public logic bundle when domain is omitted or "all".

domain.description: Optional. Defaults to "all". Prefer a single domain unless the whole public bundle is needed.

tools.name: get_3p_audit_logic
tools.description: Return public marketplace 3P audit rules: evidence ladder, formulas, DoorDash mappings, claim boundaries, and payout tolerance.

tools.name: list_answers
tools.description: List published public AEO answers (slug, title, question, audience, URL). No private store data.

limit.description: Optional max rows. Omit to return the full published catalog.

tools.name: list_free_agents
tools.description: List CSV-runnable free agents (slug, name, seat, headline, catches, sample signal, public URLs). Catalog only.

tools.name: list_agent_jobs
tools.description: List the public one-agent-one-job registry: supervisor + labor/vendor/voids/action-shift/memory, plus company roles and free-agent product catalog.

tools.name: list_specialists
tools.description: List domain specialists (labor, vendor, voids, action-shift, memory) with one job each, allowed tools, and MCP resource URIs. The supervisor routes each request. Supported one-off checks are public. To save restaurant records, new owners can sign up at https://app.never86.app/signup

tools.name: analyze_labor
tools.description: Analyze an operator-provided labor or time-clock CSV for schedule-versus-actual drift, early clock-ins, late clock-outs, overtime concentration, and possible shifts with no attached sales. Returns Unverified observations only; it never alleges theft or misconduct.

csv.description: CSV text with Location, Employee, Scheduled Start/End, and Clock In/Out. Optional Net Sales and Wage Rate improve the report.

tools.name: analyze_beverage
tools.description: Analyze an operator-provided beverage / bar CSV for pour-vs-inventory or package cost patterns. Returns Unverified review leads only; no count means no beverage-cost claim; never invents pour cost or names theft.

csv.description: CSV text for beverage cost scoring (item, pours/sales, inventory or package fields per the beverage score adapter).

tools.name: convert_uom
tools.description: Convert verified restaurant package sizes into pour/portion units (bottle mL → fl oz, keg gal → fl oz, pours per package, cost per pour). Refuses invented pack size or pourSpec. Fluid ounce ≠ weight ounce. House pour ounces come from ask_pour_standards / declare_pour_standards — never assume 1.5.

op.description: Conversion operation. Use knowledge for the full UoM pack. Fountain BIB ops need operator-declared mix ratio + cup liquid fill — never invent 5+1 or ice fill. estimate_cup_liquid uses ice-pack interview bands (15/25/40%) as Estimated only.

pour_spec_fl_oz.description: House pour in fl oz from THIS unit (1.5, 1.75, 2, or custom). Required for pours_per_package — never invent.

syrup_gal.description: Fountain BIB syrup gallons (e.g. 5). Not finished beverage gallons.

water_parts.description: Operator-declared water parts in mix ratio (e.g. 5 for 5+1). Never invent.

syrup_parts.description: Operator-declared syrup parts in mix ratio (usually 1).

liquid_fill_fl_oz.description: Liquid fl oz after ice + straw. Cup mark alone is not enough.

ice_pack.description: For estimate_cup_liquid: light~15% / medium~25% / heavy~40% ice displacement. Estimated only — 9 oz heavy ≈ 5.4 oz liquid.

spirit_fl_oz.description: House spirit pour already in the cup — reduces soda fill.

tools.name: ask_pour_standards
tools.description: Interview pack for THIS restaurant unit’s drink pour sizes. Returns questions and choice menus (1.5 / 1.75 / 2 oz, etc.). Does not invent a house pour. Call before costing drink recipes.

store_id.description: Store / unit id. Pour standards are per unit.

location_id.description: Optional bar / location within the store.

tools.name: declare_pour_standards
tools.description: Validate operator-answered house pour lines for one unit (e.g. shot 1.5, mixed 1.75, wine 5). Returns Missing Evidence for unanswered categories. Does not write memory — returns a Memory Curator proposal for human approve.

tools.name: ask_fountain_standards
tools.description: Interview pack for fountain / bag-in-box gun soda at THIS unit: BIB syrup gallons, invoice $, mix ratio (e.g. 5+1 — ask, never invent), cup mark, and liquid fill after ice + straw. Call before costing Pepsi-gun recipes.

store_id.description: Store / unit id. Fountain standards are per unit.

product_hint.description: Gun product label if known (e.g. Pepsi).

tools.name: analyze_recipe_cost
tools.description: Cost a plate (mode=recipe), a liquor drink (mode=drink_recipe), or a fountain+spirit drink (mode=fountain_spirit_drink). Drink recipes pull liquor fl oz from THIS unit’s house pour; fountain soda needs BIB mix ratio + cup liquid fill after ice — never assume 1.5 / 1.75 / 2 or 5+1. Also EP unit cost / food COGS / food-cost % when counts and sales share scope. Unverified math; never invents yield or treats an invoice as COGS.

store_id.description: Required for drink_recipe. Pour standards are per unit.

house_pour_lines.description: For drink_recipe: operator-declared pour lines for THIS unit (from declare_pour_standards). Empty → Missing Evidence + ask.

ingredients.description: recipe: [{name?, epQty, epUnitCost}]. drink_recipe: liquor lines use pourCategory + house pour; fixed/recipe_specific need epQty.

pourSource.description: house (default with pourCategory) uses unit pourSpec; recipe_specific needs explicit epQty; fixed = syrup/juice.

liquid_fill_fl_oz.description: Liquid fl oz after ice + straw — not the cup mark alone.

spirit_pour_fl_oz.description: THIS unit’s mixed-drink liquor pour for the spirit line.

spirit_cost_per_fl_oz.description: Spirit cost per fl oz after bottle pack conversion.

tools.name: analyze_vendor_prices
tools.description: Read an operator-provided vendor invoice or purchasing CSV SKU by SKU and surface price increases greater than 5% between the two latest periods. Returns Unverified evidence for operator review; it never contacts a vendor or claims guaranteed savings.

csv.description: CSV text with Vendor, SKU or Description, Period or Invoice Date, and Unit Price. Category is optional.

tools.name: build_action_shift
tools.description: Turn one restaurant's prior-day close into no more than three prioritized actions plus a night proof checklist. Uses only operator-supplied data and targets, labels results Unverified, and never converts a variance into a theft, discipline, contract, or guaranteed-savings claim.

business_date.description: Prior complete restaurant business date, preferably YYYY-MM-DD.

labor_target_pct.description: Operator-approved target only; omit when unknown.

target_delivery_minutes.description: Operator-approved target only; omit when unknown.
